name: Aditya Infotech Ltd
about: Aditya Infotech Limited (AIL) manufactures and provides video security and surveillance products, solutions, and services under the brand name 'CP Plus'.[1]
keyPoints:
Leading Surveillance Company[1]
Aditya Infotech Limited is India's largest provider of video security and surveillance products, solutions, and services by revenue, commanding a 20.8% market share as of FY2025 under its 'CP PLUS' brand, serving both enterprise and consumer segments.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 54.5% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 12.0 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.259 Cr.
